changelog: Cash in Hand — a new screen under Money & Reports. Every cash receipt now stays on the book of the person who took it, so you can see at a glance how much of the shop's money is in whose pocket. Managers see everybody; each person always sees their own.

Handing cash over: pick the person, enter the amount, press Hand over. A 6-digit code appears on THEIR screen. They count the money, read the code out, you type it in — only then is it taken off your book and put on theirs. Neither person can move money alone.

A code lasts 30 minutes and locks after 5 wrong tries; a new one can be issued at any time. The receiver can turn a handover down, the sender can cancel it, and one nobody finished expires on its own — in every case the money simply stays where it was.
You cannot hand over more than you are holding, and money already promised in an unfinished handover is not counted as free.
The User Performance report has a new Cash In Hand column (also in the Excel export), and the dashboard shows what you are holding plus the code for anyone waiting to hand you money.

Every handover is kept for good with a reference number, both names, the amount and the outcome. Completed handovers are never edited or deleted — a mistake is put right by handing the money back the other way.
